Ethan Park: FYI customer GreenLoop (acct_gl_209) got two invoices for May. first had vendor surcharge, second missing surcharge and included a partial charge token in the PDF email. ticket#79921 :grimacing:
Sofia Alvarez: ugh. pdf leaking token? can you attach the two invoice IDs and the emailed token snippet?
Ethan Park: inv_20260501_GL_A and inv_20260501_GL_B. emailed snippet shows `charge: ch_tok_***_9f3a` (partial but identifiable).
Maya Jensen: that token should never be surfaced. logs from invoice-run show retry path executed when external VAT/surcharge service timed out. retry recalculated lines without vendor_surplus because the vendor sync hadn't returned yet.
Sofia Alvarez: can you paste the relevant log lines?
Ethan Jensen: ```WARN 2026-05-01T03:59:59Z billing: start-invoice acct=acct_gl_209 key=2026-05-01
INFO 2026-05-01T04:00:01Z vendor-sync: surcharge=12.50 line_hash=zzx11
ERROR 2026-05-01T04:00:02Z vendor-sync: timeout -> returning empty
INFO 2026-05-01T04:00:03Z billing: invoice-complete lines=[compute:1200.00, vat:240.00] line_hash=yyw22
WARN 2026-05-01T04:00:04Z billing: retry triggered for key=2026-05-01 reason=timeout
INFO 2026-05-01T04:00:05Z billing: invoice-complete lines=[compute:1200.00, vat:240.00, surcharge:12.50] line_hash=zzx11
INFO 2026-05-01T04:00:06Z emailer: sending invoice inv_20260501_GL_B to billing@greenloop.com (attachments: invoice.pdf)
ERROR 2026-05-01T04:00:07Z pdf-gen: redacted_token_mismatch -> partial_token_written=ch_tok_***_9f3a```
Sofia Alvarez: looks like two issues: 1) nondeterministic vendor-sync causes different line_hashes on retry, creating duplicate invoices; 2) pdf generator attempted to redact the token but failed on retry pipeline, leaving a partial token.
Maya Jensen: agree. proposed immediate remediation: stop outbound invoice emails for same invoice-key until invoice is marked stable; issue a manual reissue with full redaction; and credit any over/under charges. long-term: add a vendor-sync gating step and strengthen pdf redaction tests.
Ethan Park: finance: can we credit the duplicate invoice and reissue the correct one? customer is in EU - VAT needs verification.
BillingOps: approved: credit the duplicate inv_20260501_GL_B, reissue invoice matching inv_A, and issue customer note. also open an audit log entry and notify legal about token exposure.
Sofia Alvarez: running a dry-run regen on branch fix/vendor-gate-and-pdf-redact now (redacting tokens fully in preview). Dry-run preview: `account: acct_gl_209, period: 2026-05-01, lines: [compute: $1200.00, surcharge: $12.50, vat: $241.25], total: $1453.75` (token fields redacted).
Maya Jensen: I'll add a test that simulates delayed vendor sync and asserts dedupe logic uses line_hash signature to avoid creating a second invoice when the first eventually contains the vendor line. PR: billing/373-dedupe-by-linehash.
Ethan Park: support will send the customer: apology, replacement invoice, and credit note. also need to confirm no PII/keys were exposed beyond the partial token.
BillingOps: TASK-10021 created for customer comms + legal review, assigned to Sofia. Monitoring enabled for acct_gl_209 for 72h.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll follow up once legal signs off on the disclosure wording. tagging @SupportBot to close ticket once reissue+credit done.
SupportBot: ticket#79921 updated: follow-up tasks created, customer notified when reissue available.
